headline: Sunday, November 15 — surgery eve, rain moves in by afternoon, iron day

sections.lead: Your Kaiser surgery is tomorrow: arrive 11:30 AM Monday at the Sand Creek Building, 2nd floor, Antioch Medical Center (4501 Sand Creek Rd) with Dr. Geraldine Shirzai.
items: The surgeon's office replied: arrive Monday, Nov 16, 11:30 AM (they open earlier), need a driver
Plan ahead: stop food 8 hours before arrival, so nothing to eat after about 3:30 AM Monday; take your usual meds with small sips of water
Also Monday: Josiah has his 2:00 PM appointment with Timothy Wong (psychiatry) at Delta Fair Medical Offices, 3454 Hillcrest Ave, Antioch — a Kaiser reminder arrived Saturday night
Both land on the same day, so it's worth knowing who is on the driver run and who takes him

sections.lead: Dry most of the day, then real rain moves in by late afternoon: rain 77% today, high 64, low 51.
items: Hour by hour: 8am 56, 10am 61, noon 63, 2pm 63 (44% rain), 4pm 59 light rain likely, 6pm 57 light rain, 8pm 57, 10pm 57
Morning errands are dry; rain is a good bet from 4pm on
Week: Mon partly sunny 59/44 (surgery day), Tue mostly cloudy 59/44, Wed rain 75% 50/45, Thu heavy rain 85% 50/46, Fri rain 65% 52/43, Sat partly sunny 57/41

sections.lead: Nerves are normal today and the sky backs it: a restless Aquarius Moon sits opposite your Leo Sun, so the mind spins while the rest of you wants quiet.
items: Plain read: one more prep day. Doing the checklist (meds laid out, driver plan, clothes ready) is the single best thing you can do for the nerves
A soft Neptune touch on your Venus makes the evening genuinely restful if you let it: warm light, quiet, early night
How to use it: finish prep this morning, rest tonight, and let tomorrow take care of itself

Details: Moon Aquarius 7.3 deg, waxing crescent (Sun-Moon 73.1); Moon opposite natal Sun (orb 1.9); Neptune R trine natal Venus (orb 0.7); Pluto sextile natal Moon (orb 1.0); Venus conjunct natal Moon (orb 2.0); Sun trine natal Mercury (orb 2.0); Mercury R square natal Sun (orb 2.0); Saturn R trine natal Sun (orb 2.3)

sections.lead: Same three cards, nothing new cleared the filters.
items: Vulcan Asphalt Dispatcher (Napa), Aubry Dispatch & Safety Coordinator (Hayward), Cemex Dispatcher (French Camp) are unchanged
Zero new dispatch leads: the Job Hunt tab stands as-is

sections.lead: Four opened overnight; one looks stale, one is a no, one is Monday's reminder.
items: Pre-Employ (Friday 2:19 PM) sent another 'attention needed' nudge for the Granite background check, with a form link — but it arrived before your Friday wrap-up, and Briana in Granite HR cleared you after, so it looks handled; if you never filled their form, the link is in the mail and worth 10 minutes today
Cardinal Health passed on your Transportation Manager, 3PL Services application (we are pursuing other applicants)
Josiah's appointment reminder (Monday 2 PM, Timothy Wong, psychiatry, Hillcrest Ave) — details above
No interview requests

sections.lead: News is thin on a storm Sunday; one local item.
items: Antioch High football fell 28-21 to the Houston Mustangs in the postseason Friday night, despite 290 yards on the ground
The atmospheric river keeps moving through the Bay Area today

sections.lead: Iron day (Sunday), and it is prep-then-rest.
items: Easy win: lay out tomorrow's meds (Gallifrey, Protonix, Zoloft) and clothes tonight so morning-of is brainless
Take iron with breakfast, as usual for a Sunday
The 10am/7pm apply runs, 3pm sweep and 5pm site check all continue on their own
Ride: after the rain starts at 4pm, keep any drive short

sections.lead: Tony's and the Family calendars are clear for Sunday.
items: Nothing on either calendar
